To create this component, you'll need to use our code editor to create a new file called EntryCard.jsx inside the existing folder src.
We've provided you with this file ourselves, so you need not worry about actually creating it. Still, it's a good idea to tinker around with the code editor and write the code yourself.
Anyway, here's the code for the component:
Here, EntryCard() is a function that returns JSX. The export default EntryCard at the end makes it available to other files.
But when you run this code, you'll be sure to get an error. That's because we haven't imported the component to our app yet.
Also notice that we've resorted to hardcoded data. That's because the required data is in a separate file, i.e., our root App component.
You'll learn how to pass data between different components later. For now, let's focus on fully integrating this EntryCard component into your app!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
